messages:
alex: Pulled key items from the postmortem and put them here — we need clear owners + dates for remediation + tests. main recurring pattern: KV cache warmup + sudden latency spikes during bursty small requests. can folks confirm ownership?
mina: I can own the regression suite additions (nightly + PR gate). plan: add 3 new test cases covering small-batch warmup and prefix-cache miss patterns. ETA: 2024-04-09. assigning RED-2467 for tracking. :white_check_mark:
jordan: I'll take prompt-set curation and sample prompts that reproduce the model mismatch we saw. will add a small eval harness and objective metrics. ETA: 2024-04-05. linking RED-2470.
tim: I'll own load-test adjustments and the chaos drill schedule. propose we run a focused chaos drill next Wed (2024-04-03) during low traffic window and a follow-up on-call tabletop. also will add SLO violation scenarios to the load suite. ETA for test changes: 2024-04-07.
oncall-bot: reminder: upcoming canary capacity test scheduled by tim on 2024-04-03 02:00 UTC — will post incident playbook link.
sre-runbook-bot: playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-warmup-spikes (auto-post)
mina: For the regression tests I'll add a short description and pseudo-config to the repo. example snippet:```yaml
- name: kv_warmup_small_batch
  model: gpt-3.5-like
  seq_len: 256
  batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
  warmup_prefix: short
  metrics: [p95_latency, cold_start_tokens]
```
alex: Nice. We also need cross-team reviewers (eng-runtime + eng-sre) so these don't get merged without perf signoff. can @jordan and @tim co-review?
jordan: yes, will review perf impact and prompt stability.
tim: I'll review load test changes. quick ask: do we want regression to run on every PR or just on critical model rollouts? my vote: PR gate for infra/runtime changes, nightly for model/config updates. thoughts?
mina: agree with that split. PR gate is expensive if it always runs — keep it targeted.
alex: Agreed. Action items summary (I'll keep this updated in RED-2467):
- Mina: add 3 regression cases + PR gate filters — ETA 2024-04-09 — RED-2467
- Jordan: prompt-set curation + eval harness — ETA 2024-04-05 — RED-2470
- Tim: load test updates + chaos drill on 2024-04-03 + follow-up tabletop — ETA 2024-04-07 — RED-2471
- Alex: coordinate cross-team reviews and finalize rollout policy — ETA 2024-04-04

Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept the owner/timeline or suggest a new date. I'll follow up with a short checklist PR template for these kinds of postmortem-driven tests so we have consistent coverage.
mina: :thumbsup: accepting ownership. will add TODOs in the repo and link PR soon.
jordan: :thumbsup:
tim: :thumbsup: scheduling the drill now.
alex: Thanks — I'll ping product/sre if we need to expand the scope. tagging for visibility: @eng-sre @eng-runtime
